{{Top|leg}}
'''Heldar''' was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Heldar recommended that clients wear [[wrist laser]]s for protection while travelling, since most physical pat-downs did not detect them.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
